description: compose start SIGTERMs whatever supervisor the machine-wide PID file names (server/supervisor.js:80-93 killExistingSupervisor) before binding :4001, so starting the app from any project replaces another project's running server. Took down the owner's server during COMP-HOST-PORTABILITY-1. Verify ownership (same target project) and require explicit takeover, or scope supervisor identity per project. Gap G8.

links.note: Gap G8; incident during the host C arm

completions.notes: Gap G8 from COMP-HOST-PORTABILITY-1, the operability incident that took down the owner's :4001 server during the audit. killExistingSupervisor() SIGTERMed whatever PID the install-wide .compose-supervisor.pid named, with no ownership check, because the file is keyed on COMPOSE_HOME rather than the target project. The file now holds an ownership record (pid, targetRoot, startedAt) at the same path; same-project restart is unchanged, a stale record proceeds silently, and a cross-project start exits non-zero naming the owning project and PID unless compose start --takeover is passed. The decision is a pure exported function, so it is tested without launching a supervisor. Accepted residual, stated in the CHANGELOG: a legacy bare-PID file carries no project identity, so one post-upgrade restart keeps the old kill behavior. Verified with COMPOSE_PORT=19997: supervisor-ownership 6/6 (no existing test imports server/supervisor.js); full suite 7236/7238 (one load-only flake, one pre-existing red owned by another session). No probe ever ran compose start, per the standing rule. Codex run 78f5bebecf45 (sol/high).
